name: fig21_density_matrix_eigenvalues
caption: Eigenvalue distributions of random density matrices. (a) Hilbert-Schmidt measure (G G^dagger normalised, square Ginibre G) for d = 64 follows the Marchenko-Pastur law with c = 1 (support [0, 4]). (b) The reduced state of a Haar-random 16 x 64 bipartite pure state follows Marchenko-Pastur with c = m/n = 1/4 (support [1/4, 9/4]); the gap at zero is the signature of a subsystem much smaller than its complement (Page regime).
